rows.text: stores the fifth (stack) argument at dword `+0x3a58` and `edx`, `r8d` and `r9d` at dwords `+0x3a4c`, `+0x3a50` and `+0x3a54` of `rcx`

with `p` = `rcx`+4, stores byte `[rcx+2]` at byte `p+0xc2` and byte `[rcx]` as word `p+0xc0`, stores `p` in the qword slot byte `[rcx]` of the array at qword `[qword 02EBEFA0]`, calls `004FF270(p, dword 02EBB738 + the low dword of p)` and returns `p` + `edx` (sign-extended)
